description: Bolivia’s electricity and renewable-energy geoportal publishes a collection of spatial layers, maps and documents. Its GeoNode interface identifies energy infrastructure and resources, with utilities and climate information among its categories. The provider is Viceministerio de Electricidad y Energías Renovables. Coverage: Coverage is Bolivia; individual layers have their own spatial extent, resolution and dates. The landing-page totals describe the portal inventory, not checked data completeness. Access: The public collection page provides layer, map and document browsing. No sign-in was used and no geographic payload was downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: GeoNode supports both public and restricted layers. The reviewed page does not establish one collection-wide licence or uniform access rights. For simulation it supplies discovery routes for electricity assets and renewable-resource mapping. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this ministry energy geoportal.
